acceptance_budgets_prospective.scope: same 2 clips; <=6 total clips; bounded calls (STT<=8 passes spent, translation only if genuinely necessary); zero new models/training; unknown timing exposed, never credited
acceptance_budgets_prospective.technical_acceptance: UNSPECIFIED: any product acceptance numbers require a later Audio decision; this contract sets none

allowed_evidence_use: diagnostic case attribution and next-branch selection only; no prevalence, generalization, or production-readiness claims
amendment_F2: Invented p50-500ms / false-cut-gate numbers removed; measurement budgets are actual small scope; technical acceptance unspecified pending Audio decision. Identity psem.evidence_delivery_gap.contract.v1 preserved.
audio_prerequisites: Audio-owned source-time applied-boundary receiver with commit/ack reporting (applied source position, application time, or reason-not-applied)
stated provider commit semantics: which already-delivered content is mutable and for how long
no-PSEM delivery baseline profile on the declared support scope

authority.governs: #133 Child P1 under #132; written BEFORE any case selection or causal inspection

causal_rules: future evidence MUST NOT be credited before its availability/decision time
a retrospectively correct boundary counts as recovered ONLY if the downstream path can actually apply it (applied boundary recorded, or Audio ack)
no oracle transcript, no source separation, no speaker-conditioned ASR, no boundary before evidence availability, no unsupported rollback in the ideal intervention
unmatched runs are NOT automatically acoustic false positives (timing/matching failures possible)
ordinary delivery separation that already prevents harm MUST be classified ALREADY_SEPARATED_BY_DELIVERY, not as a recoverable PSEM failure
correct-but-late vs acoustically-wrong MUST be separated before any branch claim
simultaneous-speech lexical damage MUST be separated from sequential segmentation damage
unknown vs measured MUST be explicit; rollback or future evidence MUST NOT be credited
harm_categories: simultaneous-speech lexical mixing unrepairable by segmentation

applied_delivery_boundary.definition: source position actually split/reowned by the Audio/provider path, with application/commit time or reason-not-applied

delivered_consequence.definition: user-visible ASR/translation harm per harm_categories, measured against no-PSEM baseline on the same material

evidence_run_confirmation.definition: persistence/confirmation of frame evidence into a decision-bearing run (horizon, threshold, mask/reset handling)

provider_applicability.definition: whether Audio/provider can still apply the requested boundary (mutability window, commit state)

reference_state.definition: reference identity, generation/scope, validity, enrollment/rebind/retention state covering the interval

requested_source_boundary.definition: source position the speaker path asks delivery to apply, with request/decision time

semantic_transition_hypothesis.definition: confirmed speaker-continuity vs transition hypothesis projected to a source boundary (tolerance-explicit)

source_speaker_evidence.definition: per-source-interval acoustic speaker observation with validity/coverage flags
